blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — Cloudy skies with scattered rains and thunderstorms will continue to affect the Visayas and Mindanao on Thursday, October 15, due to the Intertropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ). Similar weather conditions are expected in the Bicol Region, Quezon, and Palawan, according to the state weather bureau’s daily forecast. The Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) warned that moderate to at times heavy rains may trigger flash floods or landslides in affected areas.
